facts.fact: The Communications Authority of Kenya's cyber-threat update says 10.6 million advisories on web application attacks were issued in the quarter ended June 2026, and it advised organisations to disable SSL 3.0 and patch.
facts.system: Communications Authority of Kenya cyber threat reporting

facts.fact: The Communications Authority of Kenya reported 2.36 billion cyber threat events for April to June 2026 (system attacks 2.25 billion, malware 59 million, brute-force 24.2 million) and 10.6 million advisories issued, a 1.9% rise on the prior quarter.
